info.title: BotDashboard API
info.description: API per la gestione del Bot Dashboard con telemetria, comandi e statistiche real-time

post.summary: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token.

requestBody.description: The login request containing username and password.

get.summary: Test endpoint to verify API is running (no authentication required).

post.summary: Logs out the current authenticated user.

Step 1: Generates a password reset token for the specified email.
Sends an email with the token (in production).

requestBody.description: The reset password request containing the email address.

post.summary: Step 2: Confirms the password reset with the token and sets a new password.

requestBody.description: The reset password confirmation request containing email, token, and new password.

get.summary: Gets a configuration by its identifier.

post.summary:
POST /api/dashboard/reset-tables
Resetta le tabelle Value e PcCurrentStatus

POST /api/dashboard/emergency-stop
Resetta le tabelle Value e PcCurrentStatus

get.summary:
GET /api/dashboard/pc-current-status
Restituisce lo stato corrente di tutti i PC

GET /api/dashboard/margini-chart
Restituisce i punti del grafico dei margini (solo quando cambiano)
Gets a device by its identifier.
Gets ApiLogs with optional filters for CreatedAt (range), Category, and Action.

delete.summary: Deletes ApiLogs matching the given filters.

parameters.name: roleName
parameters.description: Optional role name (Admin, User, BotOperator). Default is based on IsAdmin flag.

get.summary: Gets a user by ID (Authenticated users can see their own profile, Admin can see all).
Gets all roles and permissions for a user (Admin only).

post.summary: Assigns a role to a user (Admin only).

delete.summary: Removes a role from a user (Admin only).

post.summary: Assigns a permission to a user (Admin only).

delete.summary: Removes a permission from a user (Admin only).

get.summary: Gets all available roles in the system from database (Admin only).
Gets all available permissions in the system from database (Admin only).
